image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large marine mammal, identified as a grey whale, surfacing in dark water. The image captures the dorsal side of the whale's body, showing mottled dark grey skin with lighter patches (likely barnacles or cyamids). A significant portion of the frame is occupied by white, foamy water splashing against the whale's side, indicating movement. The curvature of the back suggests a robust, spindle-shaped body. No head, tail flukes, or pectoral fins are fully visible due to the tight cropping and angle.
